## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior or finding. Explain material scope changes and link the agreed decision.

Related issue: #<!-- issue number; use a reference without automatic closing keywords -->

## Verification

Record the checks actually performed, their observed results, and the tested commit. Link durable evidence where useful. State checks not run and remaining limitations explicitly.

## Independent review

Pending. Before completion, record the independent reviewer or run, the review reference, the exact reviewed commit, and the disposition of findings. The review must cover the current head; an earlier review does not cover later changes.

## Record updates

Link updated current guidance, research, and decision records, or explain why none are needed. Note acceptance criteria still unmet and decisions still awaiting Chandler.
